title: Attachments
help: Only documents and images (PDF, HWP, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, PNG/JPG) up to 10 MB each. No limit on the number of files.
itemHelp: Members of the handling department upload and delete files (including files uploaded by others). Files can be added after completion, but not to rejected or transferred work.

errors.default: Upload failed. Please try again later.
errors.FILE_BUSY: Many files are being uploaded. Please try again in a moment.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file type is not allowed (executables, archives, etc.).
errors.WORK_STATE: Files cannot be added to rejected or transferred work.
errors.FILE_EXECUTABLE: Executable files (exe, msi, bat, cmd, com, scr, ps1, vbs, js, jar, sh) cannot be uploaded.
